purpose: Workflow for extracting requirements from Figma design files to produce design tokens and requirements documents, from preparation through quality check and completion.
summary: Lists required reading documents and the five-phase execution flow
Phase 1 checks Figma MCP availability, confirms with the user, and fetches rules and existing specs
Phase 2 builds a two-layer design system of tokens and semantic themes and identifies reusable components
Phase 3 decides placement, assigns IDs via next-spec-id, and extracts SCR, CMP, and FNC requirements
Screen requirements use screen-specific part names and ASCII layout diagrams
Supplements requirements not in the design such as errors, loading, empty states, accessibility
Phase 4 inventories image assets and records asset management policy
Phase 5 verifies tokens and documents, runs AI review, updates specs ToC, and guides commit and next steps
tasks: Creating requirements from a Figma design file
Requirements for an app redesign with Figma
Defining screen and UI component requirements
title: Figma 要件定義書作成ワークフロー
